text: So the brothers returned to Egypt, and stood once more before its ruler.
And the man in front of them asked one question.
"Do you know what you did with Yusuf and his brother, when you were ignorant?"
"I am Yusuf, and this is my brother. Allah has been gracious to us. Whoever fears Allah and is patient... Allah does not allow the reward of those who do good to be lost."
He had the power to punish them. He had every reason to.
"No blame will there be upon you today. Allah will forgive you, and He is the most merciful of the merciful."
